name: @lacspace/nepali-typing
description: Romanised Nepali → Devanagari typing with per-word candidates, like a phonetic input method: "namaste" → नमस्ते, "mero desh" → मेरो देश, "kathmandu" → काठमाडौं, "netaharulai" → नेताहरूलाई. A frequency lexicon matched by a loose key that forgives romanisation variance (aa/a, sh/s, w/v/b, ch/chh, dropped schwas, nasals), typed case endings, English loanwords (facebook → फेसबुक), a phonetic engine with ITRANS capitals (T D N Sh → ट ड ण ष), buildLexicon() from your own Nepali text and learn() to remember picks. Pure JS, zero dependencies, React Native safe.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
